STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: origen_004940.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: origen_004940.v · Open raw
module origen_004940(
    input [5:0] Opcode,
    output reg RegDst,
    output reg ALUSrc,
    output reg MemtoReg,
    output reg RegWrite,
    output reg MemRead,
    output reg MemWrite,
    output reg Branch,
    output reg Jump,
    output reg [1:0] ALUOp,
    output reg SignZero
);

always @(*) begin
    casex(Opcode)
        6'b000000: begin // R-type
            RegDst = 1'b1;
            ALUSrc = 1'b0;
            MemtoReg = 1'b0;
            RegWrite = 1'b1;
            MemRead = 1'b0;
            MemWrite = 1'b0;
            Branch = 1'b0;
            Jump = 1'b0;
            ALUOp = 2'b10;
            SignZero = 1'b0;
        end
        6'b100011: begin // Load word
            RegDst = 1'b0;
            ALUSrc = 1'b1;
            MemtoReg = 1'b1;
            RegWrite = 1'b1;
            MemRead = 1'b1;
            MemWrite = 1'b0;
            Branch = 1'b0;
            Jump = 1'b0;
            ALUOp = 2'b00;
            SignZero = 1'b0;
        end
        6'b101011: begin // Store word
            RegDst = 1'bx;
            ALUSrc = 1'b1;
            MemtoReg = 1'bx;
            RegWrite = 1'b0;
            MemRead = 1'b0;
            MemWrite = 1'b1;
            Branch = 1'b0;
            Jump = 1'b0;
            ALUOp = 2'b00;
            SignZero = 1'b0;
        end
        6'b000101: begin // Branch on not equal
            RegDst = 1'bx;
            ALUSrc = 1'b0;
            MemtoReg = 1'bx;
            RegWrite = 1'b0;
            MemRead = 1'b0;
            MemWrite = 1'b0;
            Branch = 1'b1;
            Jump = 1'b0;
            ALUOp = 2'b01;
            SignZero = 1'b0;
        end
        6'b001110: begin // XORI
            RegDst = 1'b0;
            ALUSrc = 1'b1;
            MemtoReg = 1'b0;
            RegWrite = 1'b1;
            MemRead = 1'b0;
            MemWrite = 1'b0;
            Branch = 1'b0;
            Jump = 1'b0;
            ALUOp = 2'b11;
            SignZero = 1'b1;
        end
        6'b000010: begin // Jump
            RegDst = 1'bx;
            ALUSrc = 1'bx;
            MemtoReg = 1'bx;
            RegWrite = 1'b0;
            MemRead = 1'b0;
            MemWrite = 1'b0;
            Branch = 1'b0;
            Jump = 1'b1;
            ALUOp = 2'bxx;
            SignZero = 1'b0;
        end
        default: begin
            RegDst = 1'b0;
            ALUSrc = 1'b0;
            MemtoReg = 1'b0;
            RegWrite = 1'b0;
            MemRead = 1'b0;
            MemWrite = 1'b0;
            Branch = 1'b0;
            Jump = 1'b0;
            ALUOp = 2'b00;
            SignZero = 1'b0;
        end
    endcase
end

endmodule

A stored instruction is distinct from the runtime launch message, which can add framing and execution limits. The agent uses the harness’s file-reading tools to inspect available inputs.
